title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Copilot with OneDrive files in Finder
description: We’re bringing the power of Microsoft 365 Copilot directly into your daily file management experience in macOS. With this update, users can interact with Copilot in Finder to ask questions about their OneDrive files.
